verdict.rationale: EBANX documents settlement-history tracking with 'full financial visibility' and markets 'unified reconciliation' for its Recurring Payments solution, so reconciliation is a first-party capability. Refund records and chargeback tracking exist as separate features, but nothing shows an itemized settlement report that ties these to bank deposits. missing for 10: itemized settlement/reconciliation reports, fee breakdowns, settlement-to-bank-deposit matching, refund and chargeback line items within settlement reports, report export or API documentation, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance-ops user, I can reconcile settlements to bank deposits with itemized reports covering fees, refunds, and chargebacks

citations.quote: Track your available balance, scheduled payouts, and settlement history in real time with full financial visibility.
Issue full or partial refunds quickly while maintaining transparency and accurate transaction records.
Manage, respond to, and track chargeback cases efficiently
